summary: At step 45, the wizard lava wish redraws the hero’s square while the hero is an eyeless fire elemental. C’s blind vision_recalc branch jumps to the shared epilogue, which redraws the hero over the new lava tile; JavaScript returns before that redraw and leaves the lava glyph visible. The #sit command starts at step 46, after this mismatch.

source.branch: When the hero is blind and control is not 2, vision_recalc builds COULD_SEE, redraws cells that were previously IN_SIGHT, then jumps to skip. The shared epilogue redraws the hero with newsym(u.ux, u.uy), updates the bounds, and calls notice_all_mons(TRUE).
callers: wizcmds.c:wiz_wish() -> zap.c:makewish() -> objnam.c:wizterrainwish() replaces the hero square with LAVAPOOL and calls vision.c:recalc_block_point().

vision.c:recalc_block_point() reaches block_point()/unblock_point(), which marks vision_full_recalc when the current vision array covers the square; allmain.c:moveloop_core() calls vision_recalc(0) after rhack() when the flag is set.
dependencies: display.c:newsym() redraws the hero glyph in the common epilogue; js/vision.js receives the corresponding redraw callback.
hack.c:notice_all_mons(TRUE) is the other source call in the common epilogue; js/hack.js has this helper, but vision_recalc does not call it.

evidence: The saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261007010702-v25.json, measured at 9aea0fdd726850fad5342bc3eabb32f89a78a0c0, reports 45/55 matching screens, 2653/2653 RNG calls, and 55/55 cursors. Its first mismatch is segment 0, step 45, Enter, row 18 column 69: C shows E (color 11) and JavaScript shows } (color 1). The recorded input finishes the ^W lava wish at step 45; #sit begins at step 46.

The existing one-session replay diagnostic .cache/synthetic-scans/v25/v25-sit-lava.json records 55 emitted screens and replayCommit 9aea0fdd726850fad5342bc3eabb32f89a78a0c0, reproducing the same row 18 column 69 mismatch. This reuses the saved replay; no new C recording was made.

At the evaluated upstream source nethack-c/upstream/src/vision.c:548-583, Blind recalculates COULD_SEE, repaints old IN_SIGHT cells, then uses goto skip. The shared epilogue at vision.c:843-856 calls newsym(u.ux, u.uy), updates gv.viz_rmin/gv.viz_rmax, and calls notice_all_mons(TRUE).

At the evaluated JavaScript source js/vision.js:789-805, the blind branch swaps the arrays, redraws old IN_SIGHT cells, saves the new bounds, and returns. It therefore skips the hero redraw that the ordinary path performs at js/vision.js:927. In this case that leaves the LAVAPOOL glyph over the hero; RNG and cursor traces already match.

The caller path is source-backed: objnam.c:wizterrainwish() changes levl[u.ux][u.uy] to LAVAPOOL and calls recalc_block_point() at objnam.c:3643-3665, 3872-3885; vision.c:recalc_block_point() dispatches block_point()/unblock_point() at vision.c:911-917; allmain.c:moveloop_core() calls vision_recalc(0) after rhack() at allmain.c:541-542. The C branch precondition is Blind; the session has polymorphed into a fire elemental before the wish.
